# Frontend outcome

- Feature / Product owning module:
- Approved scope and Product contract revision:
- Implementation versus mock/reserved capability:
- Files and source/test mapping:
- Actual build, tests, browser/accessibility and negative-case evidence:
- API compatibility, tenant/permission and secret handling:
- BIR rounds, exact reviewed SHA/run, canonical findings and unresolved blockers:
- Required human design/merge decisions and Product integration-pin follow-up:

Do not claim scaffold CI proves an application build or that a review grants merge authority.
